Cheap does not always mean best value

This page is the low end of the price list: every bundle we sell for GH₵30.00 or less — 7 of them today. The cheapest thing we sell is AirtelTigo 1GB at GH₵4.00 (GH₵4.00 per GB).

One thing worth knowing before you buy small: on every network we sell, the bigger bundles cost less per GB. Our cheapest bundle per gigabyte is Telecel 50GB at GH₵3.60 per GB — so if you top up the same line every week, one larger bundle usually costs less than several small ones. If you only need a little data right now, this list is the place to start; if you use data steadily, check the big bundles and compare the per-GB column.

Payment goes through Valmont-Pay — MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AT Money or card. We never see or store your MoMo PIN: you approve every charge on your own phone.

Delivery starts the moment payment confirms. Most bundles arrive within minutes; it depends on the network at the time. Every order gets a tracking reference and an SMS confirmation.

If a delivery fails we retry it automatically (up to three attempts) and refund it automatically if it still won't complete. Wrong numbers are not refundable — check the line before you pay.

Questions people ask before buying

What is the cheapest data bundle you sell?

AirtelTigo 1GB at GH₵4.00. Everything on this page is GH₵30.00 or less — 7 bundles across MTN, Telecel and AirtelTigo.

Is cheap data worse data?

No. It is the same bundle the network sells, credited to the same line — the difference is only how many megabytes you buy. What changes with size is the price per GB: bigger bundles are cheaper per GB.

Which network is cheapest per GB?

Telecel, at GH₵3.60 per GB for the 50GB bundle. Per-network the answer is in the per-GB column of the table above.

Can I pay for a small bundle with MoMo?

Payment goes through Valmont-Pay — MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AT Money or card. We never see or store your MoMo PIN: you approve every charge on your own phone.

Do cheap bundles expire?

Depends on the network, and the table says which: MTN bundles are non-expiry, Telecel and AirtelTigo bundles are 60-day rollover.
